verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents API access tokens and custom role assignment, which together let a user create scoped, least-privilege credentials for any client — and the MCP server explicitly requires an API key for tool calls (agent authenticates via this token), confirming the mechanism applies to AI-agent use. However, no docs specifically address agent-oriented token types, short-lived/ephemeral credentials, or per-tool scoping tailored to autonomous agents. missing for 10: agent-specific credential type or lifecycle, fine-grained per-tool/action scoping beyond general custom roles, independent verification that scoped tokens work end-to-end with the MCP server.
